title: banco.diagram/1
description: One drawing of a lesson/2: a diagram (A7) or a schema (A8). Release 1 types plus the wave 2 types (WAVE2 section 2): 'x-banco-release' is the batch (1, w2-1, w2-2), 'x-banco-draft' marks a W2-2 schema that is not frozen until its family's first look; what is available to authors is config/banco/lesson_types.yml. Agents write this data, our templates draw it. 'x-banco-state-keys' lists the keys a state may carry; 'x-banco-solution' marks a solution field that is never served to the browser as such; 'x-banco-hide' says which field nulls served values; 'x-banco-targets' names the select target sets; 'x-banco-home-palette' the palette a figure draws in; 'x-banco-withheld' fields come only from the check endpoint.

alt_it.description: Text alternative, 5 to 50 words (E-LESSON-ALT, checked in Ruby).

num.description: An exact number: an integer, a decimal with comma, or a fraction a/b with b > 0 (Lessons::Num, lesson/num.js).

role.description: A colour role of the lesson's subject palette (E-LESSON-ROLE, checked in Ruby).

label.description: Plain text or text with $...$; at most 6 words (checked in Ruby).

states.description: Each state overlays the top level, shallowly (A7); at most 6.

equation_parts.description: The anatomy of an equation: its parts in order (members and the = sign) and brackets over whole parts.

gaz_id.description: A gazetteer id: ISO alpha-3 (BRA), a continent or ocean id, a place or historical region id (config/banco/data).

lang_text.description: Target-language text (a key ending in _en, _es or _la); at most 12 words in running sentences (E-READ target-language set).
